leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the break-inside property to prevent content from splitting across page or column boundaries.
Configure CSS pagination rules to control how content flows in print media.
Construct a multi-column layout and implement break control within specific elements.
Manipulate page breaks before and after elements using the break-before and break-after properties.
Integrate break-inside with other CSS properties to maintain visual integrity in paginated content.
Initialize a print stylesheet that applies pagination controls to a structured HTML document.
Render a document preview that demonstrates controlled breaks across pages or columns.
